dataset_name: AI Model Extraction Detection - Normal User Query Dataset
victim_model_context: BERT news-topic classifier (World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech), same as attacker dataset v2.0.
limitations: Synthetic simulated traffic from templates, not real user logs.
Texts are generated news-style statements about invented organisations/teams; countries and cities are real names but events are fictional.
victim_prediction and victim_confidence_scores are EMPTY: must be filled from the real victim API (replay_queries_to_api.py); intended_topic is the generator's intent, not ground truth.
Timestamps are simulated; the API logger records its own arrival time unless replay preserves/forwards request_timestamp.
Exact duplicates exist by design (repeat retries and cross-user trending stories).
leakage_controls: Do not send label, attack_strategy, user_profile, query_intent or intended_topic to the API.
Join labels to API logs offline using query_id.
Exclude query_id, user_id, session_id, attack_strategy, sequence_index, generation_seed, label, user_profile, query_intent, intended_topic from detector features.
Split by user/session, never by random rows.
Send normal and attacker traffic through the same API and logging path.
